title: Spanish Version of the Talent Development Environment Questionnaire for Sport: Cultural Adaptation and Initial Validation
descriptions: This study aimed to translate the Talent Development Environment Questionnaire (TDEQ) into Spanish and provide an initial validation. The files content information about the methodology and a data set. Also it has been added a legend in order to clarify symbols and numbers included in the data set. It is a new step for TDEQ once it has been validated (also a shortened version). It will be available in Spanish for academic and professional use.
